buildCommand: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),dir='dist/assets';fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).forEach(f=>{const p=dir+'/'+f;fs.writeFileSync(p,fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace(/http:\/\/127\.0\.0\.1:8000/g,process.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL||''));})"
